Yes — that's clear. Clicking "Read later" in the sidebar narrowed the library down to just the two I'd marked, the heading switched to "Read later," and that sidebar item is highlighted as the one I'm in, so there's no confusion about what I'm looking at. That's exactly the "when I've got time, show me just the ones I set aside" view I wanted.

Now the other half of that habit for me: once I've actually read one of these, I'd want a quick way to mark it as read so it drops off this list and the count goes down — otherwise the "read later" pile just keeps growing and stops meaning anything. Can we look at that?
